HAPPY TOY V2 — EXTERNAL SOUND CREDITS

Cabinet metal latch release and seating — original project synthesis
Editable generator: SourceArt/Audio/render_cabinet_latch.py (Python 3 stdlib).
Short mechanical clacks, mono 24 kHz PCM16. No external samples or creaking
door recording is used for cabinet entry/exit.

Sound Effects Pack — OwlishMedia
https://opengameart.org/content/sound-effects-pack
CC0 1.0. Recorded shoe contacts used for the four walking pursuers, with
separate takes, mono conversion, filtering, fades and measured gain.

Impact Sounds — Kenney
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
CC0 1.0. Player footsteps and material contacts/creature attack layers.

50 RPG sound effects — Kenney
https://opengameart.org/content/50-rpg-sound-effects
CC0 1.0. Wooden sliding doors, latches, paper and mechanical contacts.

The Shop (two free samples only) — LEGIT Audio
https://opengameart.org/content/the-shop
CC0 1.0. Spatial room tones, filtered and prepared for looping.

100 CC0 SFX #2 — rubberduck
https://opengameart.org/content/100-cc0-sfx-2
CC0 1.0. Wet footsteps and original creature-contact layers.

Dripping water loop — Independent.nu; submitted by qubodup
https://opengameart.org/content/dripping-water-loop
CC0 1.0. Spatial water drops.

CC0 license: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Per-file sources, transformations and SHA-256: ThirdParty/Audio/manifest.json
All other synthesized cues are original project code. These sound credits
describe the listed acquisitions; the authors do not endorse this game.
